entities.name: Query NAD kinase
observations: 274 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A9BHU3 NAD kinase from Petrotoga mobilis.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent phosphorylation of NAD+ to NADP+; EC 2.7.1.23 and Rhea RHEA:18629.
Predicted cytoplasmic localization; binds ATP, NAD, and a divalent metal cation.
Contains Pfam NAD_kinase PF01513.27 at residues 40-104 and NAD_kinase_C PF20143.5 at residues 127-251.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is 30,016 Da and theoretical pI is 5.58.

entities.name: NAD+ kinase reaction
observations: NAD(+) + ATP = ADP + NADP(+) + H(+); Rhea RHEA:18629; EC 2.7.1.23.

entities.name: NADP biosynthesis
observations: NAD kinase supplies NADP+ from NAD+ and is part of NAD+ metabolism and NADP+ biosynthesis; GO:0006741 and GO:0019674.
